description: This file defines functions for generating an Excel report summarizing data related to a job, including documents, extractions, and entities. It interacts with database models to fetch data, creates multiple Excel sheets, autosizes columns, saves the report, and persists report metadata.

classes.name: Workbook
classes.description: An openpyxl Workbook object used to create and save Excel files.

methods.name: None _autosize(ws)
methods.description: Autosizes all columns in the given worksheet based on cell contents.

methods.description: Asynchronously generates an Excel report for a specific job, including summary, documents, extractions, and entities, then saves and logs its creation.
